besluite.fout: The relative clause 'wat niemand kan sien of aanraak nie' can attach to 'middel' instead of 'lyn'.
besluite.rede: Splitting the sentence makes it unambiguous that the axis is what nobody can see, and the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb (''n draai heet' / 'ons se').
besluite.rede: Required AWS comma; nothing else changes.

besluite.fout: The word 'dag' is mentioned as a word but not marked, so a reader can stumble on 'beteken dag'.
besluite.rede: Quotation marks match the quoted phrase just before it and make the sentence easier to read on first pass.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses ('Die Son skyn' / 'daar is dit dag').
Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('is dit oggend' / 'lyk dit').
besluite.rede: Required AWS comma; the protected 'asof' is untouched.

besluite.fout: 'van die Son af weg' doubles the direction, and the AWS comma before 'en dit word aand' is missing.
besluite.rede: 'van die Son weg' is the clean form of the separable verb and the comma is required; same action, same order.

besluite.fout: 'By jou middag' is a compressed, unidiomatic time phrase.
besluite.rede: A time clause says naturally that it is midday where you are, with no change in meaning.

besluite.fout: 'Al agt planete' lacks the article Afrikaans uses in this construction.
besluite.rede: 'Al agt die planete' is the natural idiom; the count and scope stay the same.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses ('rewolusie neem' / 'ons noem').
besluite.rede: Required AWS comma; the protected 'ongeveer 365¼ dae' stays intact.

besluite.fout: 'op dieselfde tyd' is a calque of 'at the same time'.
besluite.rede: 'terselfdertyd' is the natural Afrikaans word for simultaneity and the meaning is identical.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('draai die Aarde' / 'reis dit').
besluite.rede: Required AWS comma; nothing else changes.

besluite.fout: 'Neem ... vir die Son' copies English 'for the Sun'; standing in for something takes 'as'.
besluite.rede: In both versions the lamp represents the Sun and the ball the Earth, so the preposition fix keeps the meaning and reads naturally.

besluite.fout: 'alleen genoeg' is awkward and can be misread as 'only enough'.
besluite.rede: 'op sy eie genoeg' says plainly that the turning by itself suffices, which is what the original means.
